rows.behavior: kmctl verify adds its entry when the verified line carries a trailing YAML comment: `verified:  # checks` over a block list gets the entry appended to that list, and `verified: []  # none` becomes a list with the one entry; the comment is kept and the front matter still parses to the same entries plus the new one.
rows.fails_when: verify refuses either form, drops or corrupts the comment or another entry, or the result does not parse

rows.behavior: The full suite and every tier pass.
rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
